title: Owner's own physical impact / hitchhiker effect

tellings.quote: it's had a very real physical impact on people's lives, including mine.

plain: Whatever goes on at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange reports, has had a very real physical effect on people's lives, including the owner's own, sometimes described as something following people home. The ranch's owner says so to Jesse Michels, speaking from personal experience. The point is that the place's effects do not stay on the ranch.
